questions.prompt: Ibi n'ibihe byiza: twungutse byinshi.
questions.answer: These are good times: we have increased/profited a lot.

questions.prompt: Sinzongera kukubwira.  Ukwiriye kunyumvira.
questions.answer: I won't tell you again.  You must obey me.

questions.prompt: Ni twegera Imana, na yo izatwegera.  Mbese, mwarayegereye?
questions.answer: If we draw near to God, He will also draw near to us.  Have you drawn near to Him?

questions.prompt: Turiga byinshi.  Sinzi ko tuzabyibuka byose. Jyewe, namaze kwibagirwa byinshi.
questions.answer: We are learning a lot.  I don't know whether we will remember it all.  As for me, I have already forgotten a lot.

questions.prompt: Ntimukwiriye gupfa kubyemera
questions.answer: You must not simply agree to it.

questions.prompt: Ntabwo mushobora kumwigisha, kuko yibagirwa iteka
questions.answer: You can never teach him, because he forgets constantly

questions.prompt: Banze kucica (inka), ariko inzara yatumye babikora
questions.answer: They hated to kill them (cows, sheep or goats), but hunger/the famine caused them to do it.

questions.prompt: Ni twubaka neza, inzu izahagarara iminsi myinshi.
questions.answer: If we build well, the house will stand for many days.

questions.prompt: Inka ze ntibashobora kuzibara zose, kuko ar'umubare ugera mu bihumbi byinshi.
questions.answer: They can't count all of his cows, because it is a number that reaches into the many thousands.

questions.prompt: Narabimuhaye. Na w'azabyemera n'umubaza
questions.answer: I gave them to her.  And she will admit it if you ask her.

questions.prompt: Nzagutuma ejo.  N'ugerayo ukwiriye kumwegera no kumubwira ibyo nakubwiye byose.
questions.answer: I will send you tomorrow.  When you arrive there, you must approach him and tell him everything I have told you.

questions.prompt: Nanze kwiba kuko atari byiza.  Ibyiza n'ukumvira amategeka agenga uko abantu bagirirana
questions.answer: I refused to steal because it is not good.  What is good is to obey the laws that decree how people treat one another.

questions.prompt: Afite intama nyinshi, kandi yakomeje kuzongeraho.  N'ubundi yazongeyeho kenshi.
questions.answer: He has many sheep, and he continued to add to them.  And at other times he added to them often.

questions.prompt: Uyu mukene arakwibutsa yuko wemeye ejo ko uzamufasha.  Ndagira ngo utabikoze.
questions.answer: This poor person is reminding you that you agreed yesterday that you would help him.  I presume you have not done so.

questions.prompt: Mu mubare w'abantu iki gihugu cyungutse, nkwiriye kukwibutsa yuko hariho benshi bataremera kumvira amategeko yahanzwe vub'aha.
questions.answer: In the number of people this country has increased, I must remind you that there are many who don't agree to obey the laws that were enacted recently.

questions.prompt: Pfa kubigerageza, ahari bizamwibutsa.
questions.answer: Just try it; perhaps it will remind him

questions.prompt: Hari umugani uvuga yuko uburyo bwo gutsinda bugenda buhoro buhoro.
questions.answer: There is a proverb that says that the road to success goes inch by inch (little by little)

questions.prompt: Ni wemera kubaka inzu yanjye, nzatuma wunguka amafaranga menshi.
questions.answer: If you agree to build my house, I will cause you to gain much money

questions.prompt: Nzi ibyo wibwira: uratekereza yuko bidashoboka, ariko si ko biri
questions.answer: I know what you are saying to yourself: you are thinking that it is not possible, but that is not so.

questions.prompt: Ibagirwa ibyo nakubwiye byose.  Nashatse kukwibutsa gusa.
questions.answer: Forget everything I told you.  I only wanted to remind you.

questions.prompt: Intumwa ntizivuga izazo magambo, ahubwo zikwiriye kuvuga ayo uwazitumye
questions.answer: Messengers don't speak their own words; to the contrary, they must say what the one who sent them said.

questions.prompt: Ntabwo yemeye.  Ahari azemera n'abona ukuntu bahindutse abakene rwose.
questions.answer: She never agreed.  Perhaps she will agree if she sees how they have become totally destitute people.

questions.prompt: Sindabona uburyo bwo kubara umubare w'ibyo azunguka, kukw ari byinshi cyane.
questions.answer: I have not yet found a way to count the amount of his profits because it is very high.

questions.prompt: Orororo!  Nishe ikirenge!  Aya mabuye n'ibyago.
questions.answer: Ouch!  I have wrecked my foot!  These stones are a plague.

questions.prompt: Yego, n'ukuri, yaranyibukije, ariko narabyibagiwe.  Mpora nibagirwa.
questions.answer: Yes, it is true; she reminded me, but I forgot.  I keep forgetting.

questions.prompt: Ndizera ibyo avuga byose.  Yego, ndabyizera rwose.
questions.answer: I believe everything he says. Yes, I really believe it.

questions.prompt: Sinshobora gusoma ibyo atarwanditseho.
questions.answer: I can't read that which he has not written on it.

questions.prompt: Ntukwiriye kwiringira ubutunzi kuko utazabujyana
questions.answer: You must not put your trust in riches, because you will not take them with you to the grave.

questions.prompt: Inshuti ze ntizizera ibyo wamubwiye nubwo wabyeruye rwose.
questions.answer: His friends will not believe what you told him even though you made it very plain.

questions.prompt: Abakristo bizera yuko Bibiliya ar'ijambo ry'Imana; ni cyo gituma baryizera.

questions.prompt: Utwana twiba dukwiriye guhanwa

questions.prompt: Sinzi ko babaho kuko abahagiye batababonye
